messages:
maria-cs: Quick alert 17:12 UTC 11 we're seeing onboarding delays for tenants provisioned during last night's EU index migration. ~15 tenants affected (12 trials, 3 high-touch). Need customer comms + localized notes + proposed credits.

ashley-se: Can you DM the tenant list and a 1-line root cause? ETA on full recovery?

maria-cs: DMing list now. Root cause: indexer backlog + aggressive provisioning retries hit a rate-limiter during migration traffic. We think a config tweak and extra workers will clear backlog.

sam-eng: Mitigations applied: spun extra indexer workers, relaxed retry backoff for provisioning, and temporarily widened limiter window for onboarding traffic. Queue depth dropping. Expect most tenants to be caught up in 30-45m.

neil-ops: Limiter config rolled at 17:18 UTC, queue alerts cleared. Monitoring for regression. :eyes:

john-vp-cs: Customer offer suggestion: 2 weeks credits + 1:1 office hours for the 3 high-touch customers; 1 week credits + recorded office hours for trials. Also offer prioritized manual import if needed. Agree?

maria-cs: Agree. Draft outbound note below; will request FR/DE/ES localizations.

```
Subject: Update: onboarding delay during EU migration — remedial steps and offer

Hi <Customer name>,

We encountered a provisioning delay for customers onboarded during a recent platform migration in the EU region. Our engineering team implemented a fix and your tenants index should be available shortly.

What we did: increased processing capacity, adjusted provisioning retries, and monitored the backlog until caught up.
What were offering: 1 week of platform credits (2 weeks for customers on our high-touch plan) and a 1:1 office hours slot if youd like live help. If you have an urgent import need, reply and we'll prioritize.

Sorry for the disruption  we will send a short post-incident summary and a feedback survey.

Best,
Redwood Inference Ops & CS
```

lina-localization: Ill translate subject + body FR/DE/ES. Send final copy in 20m and Ill push translated versions with region-specific office-hour CTAs.

incident-bot: INC-2026-042 created: "EU migration onboarding latency" Severity=S2 Owners=sam-eng,neil-ops,maria-cs

sam-eng: sample logs for RCA context:
```
2026-03-23T17:12:09Z provisioning.worker INFO attempt=7 tenant=tenant-441 status=retrying err="rate_limited: provisioning_window"
2026-03-23T17:12:11Z indexer.queue WARN depth=987 pending=12
2026-03-23T17:14:05Z provisioning.worker INFO attempt=1 tenant=tenant-441 status=success latency=00:02:08
```

neil-ops: Backfill complete for 9/15 tenants; 6 still catching up. Will update when all green.

maria-cs: Plan: individualized notes to the 3 high-touch accounts within 45m (include credit offer + scheduling links). Bulk localized email for trials once Lina posts translations. Include a 2-question feedback form and schedule link.

john-vp-cs: Good. Keep execs looped for any escalation. :thumbsup:

maria-cs: Posting an update here in 30m and full RCA in ~24h. Ping me directly if anything changes sooner.
